title: Week 17 Mastery Quiz

questions.question: Which definition best matches “authoritarianism”?
options: A protected freedom limiting government interference.
A political system concentrating power and limiting meaningful competition, accountability, and civil liberties.
Cross-border investment, lending, borrowing, or asset purchase.
A method that does not privilege a political party or require ideological agreement.
questions.explanation: Authoritarianism means a political system concentrating power and limiting meaningful competition, accountability, and civil liberties.
choices: A protected freedom limiting government interference.
A political system concentrating power and limiting meaningful competition, accountability, and civil liberties.
Cross-border investment, lending, borrowing, or asset purchase.
A method that does not privilege a political party or require ideological agreement.

The process through which people develop political values, identities, and habits.
An extreme authoritarian system seeking pervasive control over political, social, economic, and private life.

A union in which member states retain substantial sovereignty and the central authority is limited.
The administrative process of turning an adopted policy into operations and outcomes.

A cost that changes with output.

A student compares systems using observable institutions and outcomes rather than assuming an election or constitutional label proves democracy.
